title: Refund Schedule for Cancelled Tailwise Grooming Salon Prepaid Passes
content:
*Billing and refunds desk — Tailwise Grooming Salon prepaid passes (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes).*

**A. Full refund.** A cancellation requested no later than the pass's full-refund window in calendar days after the purchase date, that date being day 0, of a pass with no used visit is refunded the price paid in full. A request on the last day of the window is in time.

**B. Every other cancellation.** A used visit is a completed visit, a no-show or a forfeit recorded on the pass with one visit taken, and the per-visit paid rate is the price paid divided by the visits purchased. The refund on a cancelled pass is the unused value, that is the price paid less the used visits at the per-visit paid rate, less the pass's refund admin fee and less the late-cancellation fees booked on the pass, rounded half up to the cent once on the final amount and never below 0.00. The unused visits are removed and the refund goes to the original payment.

**C. Rounding.** Half up means a figure lying exactly on a half cent goes to the higher cent; a tolerance of 0.0001 cent is added to the final amount before it is rounded.

**Records read**

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| price paid, visits purchased, purchase date | the pass record |
| used visits | completed visits, no-shows and forfeits in the salon history of the pass, each taking one visit |
| late-cancellation fees booked | the late-cancellation fee entries in the salon history of the pass, totalled |
| refund admin fee, full-refund window | the pass terms table, by pass name |

**Worked schedule (hypothetical Full Groom Pass 6-Visit, price paid 428.40, 6 visits purchased, admin fee 15.00)**

| Line | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| per-visit paid rate: 428.40 divided by 6 | 71.40 |
| two used visits at 71.40 | 142.80 |
| unused value: 428.40 less 142.80 | 285.60 |
| less the refund admin fee | 15.00 |
| less one late-cancellation fee entry booked on the pass | 20.00 |
| **refund** | **250.60** |

**Window on the boundary (hypothetical pass bought 1 March, 14-day window, no used visit)**

| Cancellation requested | Day | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 14 | price paid in full |
| 16 March | 15 | under B |

A pass bought 1 March with one completed visit and cancelled on 3 March is refunded under B, a visit having been used.

**Floor.** Where the fees and the admin fee exceed the unused value, the refund is 0.00.
